subject: english
question:
**Select the correct direct narration of the given sentence.**

The government admits that the number of Covid-19 cases is on the rise.

options.text: “The number of Covid-19 cases will be on the rise,” the government says.
“The number of Covid-19 cases is on the rise,” the government admits.
“The number of Covid-19 cases has been rising,” the government said.
“The number of Covid-19 cases was on the rise,” the government admits.

solution:
The correct answer is** “The number of Covid-19 cases is on the rise,” the government admits.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in Indirect Speech. As per the question, we have to change it into Direct Speech. 
 
• The process of transformation is as follows:
 
 
• 'admits' will not change because the reporting verb is in the **present tense. **
 
• We don't change the tense of reported speech when reporting verb is in the present tense.
 
• Commas and inverted commas will be added. 
 
• Hence,*** 'The number of Covid-19 cases is on the rise' ***will remain as it is.

 
 
 

Correct Sentence:__ *“The number of Covid-19 cases is on the rise,” the government admits.*
